milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The player must navigate near the red concrete structure (centered at spawn-relative [6, 1, 6]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure rather than just happening to be nearby.
